title: Örebro — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Örebro: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Örebro has a population of 152,000. A historic city with a fairytale castle on an island, known for its university and central location. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 74 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.

Last updated: November 07, 2026
